data.name: NI USB-6451
data.note: 20-bit simultaneous digitizer, 1 MS/s per channel, clocked by the external CONV_START signal from the timing device (PFI0, rising edge, 3.3 V). Fixed input terminals (hardcoded in the driver): ch1 differential = AI0(+)/AI8(-), ch2 differential = AI1(+)/AI9(-), ch1 single-ended = AI2, ch2 single-ended = AI3; the config selects only the channel 'termination'. Out-of-range readings clamp (railing at full scale = overflow). 'device' is the DAQmx device name — rename the card in the DAQmx driver stack to match, not the file.
